title: Ramsey Communities Neighbourhood Plan Referendum Scheduled
meetingTitle: Ramsey Town Council / Huntingdonshire District Council
summary: The Neighbourhood Plan has passed independent assessment and will proceed to a public referendum organized by Huntingdonshire District Council in December 2026.

title: Ramsey Town Council Meeting Agenda & Grant Awards
summary: Town Council meeting covering co-option of councillors, planning applications, CIL fund releases for Ramsey Football Club, grant awards for local community groups, and recommendations for CCTV and Newtown Road Playpark spending.

title: Town Council Vacancies Due to Councillor Resignations
summary: Notice given of two council vacancies following the resignations of Councillor Ash Austin and Councillor Phil Rose. An election will be held if requested in writing by ten electors within 14 statutory days to the Returning Officer at Huntingdonshire District Council; otherwise, the Town Council will fill the vacancies by co-option.

title: Planning Applications and Consultations Review
summary: Council members to review planning applications including a 2-bed bungalow at 284 Herne Road (Ramsey St Mary's), change of use to a SEN day school at Westward House (Bury Road), and complete a vote on the retail/community space units proposed for the Pedestrian Island on Great Whyte. Also discussing online planning training feedback, David Wilson Homes development feedback, and representations for the HDC Local Plan consultation.

title: Planning Application 3226/01526/FUL - Temporary Retail/Community Space on Great Whyte
summary: The Council considered an application for temporary permission (15 years) for 3 units of retail/community space and highway improvements on the Pedestrian Island, Great Whyte. An amended motion stating there was insufficient information to support the application was passed (5 for, 3 against, 6 abstentions).

title: Planning Application 25/01301/FUL - Riverside Lake and Leisure, Mereside Drove
summary: The Council voted unanimously to recommend approval for the erection of an owner/site manager's dwelling, retention of 14 touring caravan pitches, toilet/shower block, 3 holiday lodges, plus the addition of two new timber holiday lodges and four holiday pods.

title: Planning Application 26/01763/FUL - Oak Cottage, Forty Foot Bank
summary: The Council voted by majority (6 for, 8 against, 1 abstention) to recommend refusal for the erection of 3 detached dwellings, 3 detached double garages, and associated works, echoing concerns raised by neighbouring residents.

title: Planning Application 26/01763/FUL/26/01764/LBC - Bodsey House, Bodsey Toll Road
summary: The Council voted unanimously to recommend approval for the proposed conversion and extension of an existing curtilage-listed outbuilding into a separate dwellinghouse.

title: Planning Application Recommendations and Updates
summary: Council to discuss several planning applications including temporary permission for retail/community space on Great Whyte, holiday park expansions at Mereside Drove, residential developments at Forty Foot Bank and Bodsey Toll Road, and a self-build appeal at Bucks Drove.

title: Youth Funding Presentation
summary: Presentation by Ramsey Neighbourhoods Trust to the Council regarding youth funding.

title: Planning Application Recommendation: 199 Dwellings off Stoneman Way and Biggin Lane
summary: Council voted unanimously to recommend refusal for outline application 25/01382/OUT due to incorrect speed limits in the traffic assessment, coalescence concerns between Bury Village and Ramsey Town, and inadequate drainage flowing into Slade Dyke.

title: Planning Application Recommendation: Two Drive-Thru Units on St Marys Road
summary: Council voted unanimously to recommend approval for application 26/00681/FUL for the construction of 2 drive-thru units with landscaping at Plot 09A St Marys Road, Ramsey.

title: Planning Application Query: Open Storage of Vehicles at Factory Bank
summary: Council voted 11 for and 1 abstention to defer a formal vote on application 26/01584/FUL pending further information regarding agricultural land change of use, environmental contamination, drainage, and encroachment on the Northern Gateway MUGA site.

title: Planning Application Recommendation: Variation of Condition at Oilmills Road, Ramsey Mereside
summary: Council voted unanimously to recommend approval for application 26/01670/S73 (variation of condition 2 for Land Rear of 192 Oilmills Road).

title: Mews Car Park and Great Whyte Improvements Update
summary: The Mayor updated the council on positive discussions regarding the Pedestrianisation Project and a proposed 50-year leasehold for the land behind the doctors on Mews Close for parking, supported by HDC CIL funding applications.

title: Planning Application Recommendation: 25/01382/OUT (Stoneman Way and Biggin Lane)
summary: Council voted unanimously to recommend refusal for the outline application of up to 199 dwellings due to incorrect speed data in traffic assessments, concerns over coalescence between Bury and Ramsey, and inadequate drainage.

title: Planning Application Recommendation: 26/00681/FUL (St Marys Road)
summary: Council voted unanimously to recommend approval for the construction of 2 drive-thru units with associated landscaping at Plot 09A St Marys Road.

title: Upcoming Planning Consultations and Street Naming
summary: The council agenda includes reviewing major planning applications such as 199 dwellings off Stoneman Way and Biggin Lane, drive-thru units on St Marys Road, street naming for Equestrian Facilities at Middle Drove (Ramsey Heights) to 'The Meadows', and the Huntingdonshire Pre Submission Local Plan – 2046 response.
